thread:
alex: Heads-up — prepping release notes for v2.3.2. Planned deploy Wed 03:00 UTC. Need pin owners, rollback criteria, and a short internal blurb.
maria: Ack. Canary plan? I vote 10% for 30m, then 50% for 15m, then full if no regressions. :eyes:
sam: Ops +1 on canary. Also propose two-step rollback: model pin -> traffic reroute -> revert DB feature flag. Prefer pin target 2.3.0-stable as safe fallback.
julie: I can draft the internal announcement. Need 2 bullet impact points and a 1-liner for TL;DR.
alex: TL;DR: "Routing policy update to improve cost efficiency; no UI changes." Impact bullets:
- Minor routing change: shorter tail latency for large prompts
- No schema or DB migration, opt-out flag available
maria: Add note about metrics to watch: p50/p95 latency, token cost, error rate, and inference timeouts.
sam: Rollback criteria suggestion:
- >2x error rate sustained for 5m
- p95 latency increase >50% vs baseline for 10m
- token cost anomaly >30% impacting budget alerts
julie: Draft internal blurb (preview):
"Deploy Wed 03:00 UTC: routing optimizer v2.3.2. Expected benefit: ~8-12% token cost reduction for long-context workloads. No user-facing changes. Oncall: Sam, Maria. Contact #eng-oncall for incidents."
alex: Nice — keep it short. Add link to RN doc and who approves pin.
julie: I'll add approvals section: Release lead: Alex; Ops approver: Sam; Legal/SEC: not required for this one.
deploy-bot: deploybot: Schedule created for 2024-03-20T03:00:00Z — canary windows: 10%x30m -> 50%x15m -> 100%. Pins: on rollback will set model to 2.3.0-stable.
maria: Quick check: can we include the exact rollback commands in the RN? e.g.
```
# rollback
kubectl set image deploy/inference inference=redwood/inference:2.3.0-stable
```
sam: Good idea. Also include the feature-flag toggle path: /admin/feature-flags/routing_optimizer -> OFF
alex: All set. Julie — add this to the announcement and I'll send the internal slack pin 1h before deploy. :thumbsup:
julie: Will do. Tagging oncall and ops. Publishing draft to docs: https://docs.internal/release-notes/v2.3.2
alex: Thanks all — final signoff planned at 02:30 UTC tomorrow.
